overallVerdict.rationale: The system is fully deployed, functionally tested, and capable of capturing leads and generating export quotations. However, durable storage currently depends on external webhook endpoints (Google Sheets CRM) and email logging rather than a dedicated transactional SQL/NoSQL database; inbound MX DNS records are split across Hostinger and Zoho; and end-user inbox deliverability remains unverified under enterprise spam filters.

commercialRisks.description: Lack of primary relational or document database on Vercel backend. If Google Sheets webhook is unreachable, leads are only stored in email logs and browser localStorage.
commercialRisks.mitigation: Provision a serverless database (Upstash Redis, Supabase PostgreSQL, or Neon) as the primary transactional ledger.

commercialRisks.description: DNS MX records are simultaneously pointed to Hostinger (preferences 5, 10) and Zoho Mail (preferences 10, 20, 50). This split configuration can cause incoming B2B buyer inquiries to land unpredictably in different webmail platforms.
commercialRisks.mitigation: Consolidate MX records under one primary mail service (either Hostinger or Zoho Mail) and deprecate the other.

commercialRisks.description: The admin quotation interface lacks a direct one-click CSV export button and dedicated dropdown filters for country and product, requiring users to rely on search queries or the Google Sheets interface.
commercialRisks.mitigation: Implement client-side CSV table export in AdminQuotations.jsx.

prioritizedOwnerActionList.instructions: Log in to Hostinger/DNS registrar. Choose either Zoho Mail or Hostinger Webmail as the sole mail provider for sales@avaniagrofoods.com. Remove redundant MX records to eliminate split-inbox delivery.
Ensure GOOGLE_SHEETS_WEBHOOK is set in Vercel environment variables with a live Google Apps Script deployment URL to maintain continuous durable offsite lead logging.
Connect a dedicated serverless PostgreSQL (e.g., Supabase or Neon) or Upstash Redis instance to store all leads and quotations with transactional ACID guarantees.
